backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with authorization and blob‑storage mixins plus all core data types for posts, replies, listings, user profiles, admin reports, and messaging.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence metadata mapping feature IDs to affected files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides human‑written summaries for key frontend files describing UI behavior, styling, and feature‑level logic.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell that mounts the React app at #root and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component handling authentication state, tab navigation, profile setup, and admin routing.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: Global React error boundary that shows a styled fallback UI with error details and a reload button.
frontend/src/components/CreateListingDia: Dialog for creating second‑hand listings with form fields, image upload, validation, GDPR compliance flow, and Swiss‑region handling.
frontend/src/components/CreatePostDialog: Modal form for creating a post with category, content, anonymity toggle, and GDPR compliance check.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileDialo: Dialog to edit user profile details, upload a profile picture with validation, and save changes.
frontend/src/components/FeedPostCard.tsx: Displays a forum post with author info, timestamp, truncated content, and category badge.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer showing a 'Made with love' message.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Top navigation bar handling tab switching, authentication, and showing user profile initials.
frontend/src/components/ListingCard.tsx: Card for secondhand listings with image carousel, price/region formatting, and favorite toggling.
frontend/src/components/ListingDetailDia: Displays listing details with images, seller info, favorites, messaging, and GDPR compliance checks.
frontend/src/components/LoggedOutStateCa: Shows a card prompting unauthenticated users to log in via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Renders a summary card for a community post with category, author, timestamp, and preview text.
frontend/src/components/PostDetailDialog: Displays a full post with replies, allows writing new replies with GDPR compliance and anonymity options.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Provides a form for new users to set name, country, region, and motherhood status, then saves their profile.
frontend/src/components/RulesAcceptanceD: Modal requiring users to accept community rules and provide an email before posting, with validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGDPRCompliance.ts: Hook managing GDPR checks, showing a rules dialog, saving updated user profile, and executing deferred actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, loading stored identities, handling login, logout, and state flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls with React Query for profiles, posts, listings, conversations, and admin actions with auth error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styling with light/dark theme variables and custom font setup.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard fetching moderation queues, stats, activity, and enabling viewing, hiding, or deleting content.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Chat interface fetching conversations, enforcing GDPR compliance on sending messages, and handling message input and display.
frontend/src/pages/ForumPage.tsx: Displays forum posts with category filters, authentication checks, and dialogs for creating and viewing posts.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage with a hero section, login handling, and a feed of recent posts with create and detail dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows a user profile with tabs for listings and posts, supports viewing others’ profiles, editing, and loading user activity.
frontend/src/pages/SecondHandPage.tsx: Lists second-hand items with category, age, and region filters, favorites, and creation controls based on user identity and country.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read, store, and clear URL and session parameters, supporting both query and hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project state, including schema version, an app-wide summary, and a detailed list of implemented features with metadata for an ICP-based community app.
